rows.title: Effects of Cannabidiol-Rich Cannabis Oil on Facial Expression Recognition and Theory of Mind in Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a post hoc subanalysis of a small pediatric ASD trial; social-cognition findings are exploratory and cannot establish broad efficacy of CBD-rich cannabis oil.

rows.title: Investigating Neuropharmacological Features of the Cortical Activity of Cannabidiol GWP42003 P-A Phase 1 Clinical Trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: This phase 1 crossover study examined acute cortical physiology after a single high dose of purified CBD in healthy men; it is mechanistic and not an efficacy trial.

rows.title: Efficacy of ginger and fennel in relieving primary dysmenorrhea: A triple-blind crossover controlled trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: The crossover trial is specific to young women with primary dysmenorrhea and short-cycle dosing; formulation, outcome, and population limits constrain generalization.

rows.title: Omega-3 Supplementation with Lipid Biomarker Assessment in Youth with Migraine: A Quasi-Randomized Controlled Feasibility Trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a small quasi-randomized feasibility preprint in pediatric migraine; feasibility and biomarker target-engagement results should not be treated as established clinical efficacy.

rows.title: Synergistic effects of intradialytic concurrent training and melatonin supplementation on immune cell adaptations in hemodialysis patients.
rows.evidence_boundary: Melatonin was tested together with structured intradialytic exercise in hemodialysis patients, so ingredient-specific attribution is limited by the combined intervention and disease context.
